title: The formatter check runs in check mode and fails non-zero on any unformatted file
asA: operator whose project enables the elicited formatter check
iWant: a formatter gate that CHECKS (not writes) and fails on any file the formatter would rewrite
soThat: unformatted commits are caught in CI rather than masked by a rewrite step

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `checkSet.formatter` is true, the gate-runner runs the project-realised formatter runner in check mode. A non-zero exit code from the runner (indicating one or more files would be rewritten) flips the gate outcome to `failed`. The per-gate report at `.rcf/reports/ci/format.json` carries `checkKind: "formatter"`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a project with `checkSet.formatter: true` and a realised formatter runner in check mode
acceptanceCriteria.when: a CI workflow invokes the gate-runner
acceptanceCriteria.then: a report file at `.rcf/reports/ci/format.json` is written with `checkKind: "formatter"`, and the gate outcome tracks the runner exit code
